subject.title: feat(gateway): durable cloud worker environments, provider SDK contract, and lifecycle RPCs

question: Should this PR establish the permanent shared worker-provider, lifecycle-storage, and environment-RPC contracts for full-session cloud workers before the broader placement hierarchy is settled?
rationale: The canonical issue says this feature shares provisioning primitives with existing execution-placement work but creates distinct long-lived session, synchronization, security, and UI contracts; repository evidence cannot choose that permanent product hierarchy.

options.title: Approve Shared Foundation
options.body: Adopt these provider, persistence, and RPC contracts as common substrate while keeping full-session and per-spawn placement behavior distinct.

options.title: Keep Contracts Experimental
options.body: Limit or defer public plugin and protocol commitments until maintainers settle the execution-placement hierarchy.

recommendation.title: Approve Shared Foundation
recommendation.body: Adopt these provider, persistence, and RPC contracts as common substrate while keeping full-session and per-spawn placement behavior distinct.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposal and the current-main foundations it extends, making them the strongest available owner for the contract decision.
